description:
The extracted weight-loss table for the named drugs, joined to trial design, one row per arm and timepoint.

Rows are NOT collapsed to one number per drug. The corpus holds several doses, timepoints and
estimands per trial, and picking a single winner per drug would mean choosing between them
here, silently and on the caller's behalf. The comparison is theirs to make; this returns the
rows and the labels needed to make it correctly.
name: compare_efficacy
title: Compare weight-loss efficacy
